skill_name: Suggest the primary reasons why the stock market can crash.
workflow: The primary reasons why the stock market can crash are earnings disappointments, changes in the Federal Reserve’s interest rate, international crises, and a negative market outlook. Earnings disappointments occur when companies report an earnings miss instead of meeting analysts’ expectation. A change in the Federal Reserve’s interest rate can lead to market volatility, as it can affect borrowing costs and impact the velocity of money circulating in the market.
